newsitem.title: MOLDOVA: Challenger leads in early Moldova presidency count.
newsitem.headline: Challenger leads in early Moldova presidency count.

text.p: Left-wing challenger Petru Lucinschi had a strong lead over President Mircea Snegur in early counting for Moldova's presidential election on Sunday, the head of the electoral commission said.

Lucinschi, who is chairman of the national parliament, had 55.66 percent after 12.46 percent of votes in the run-off had been counted, central electoral commission chairman Petru Railean told Reuters.
Snegur, who has been president since independence in 1991, had 44.34 percent.
The count had yet to start in the capital, Chisinau, where Lucinschi is expected to do well among the former Soviet republic's large and mainly urban Russian-speaking minority.
Votes are counted by hand in the 2,000 or so polling stations and the results are then centralised at district and national level.
